## Data Summary

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
summary(params$data)
```

## Plots

```{r plots, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (length(params$plots) > 0) {
  for (p in params$plots) print(p)
} else {
  cat("No plots were selected for this report.")
}
```
